name: Should I use large-format or small mosaic tiles in a bathroom remodel?

mainEntity.name: Should I use large-format or small mosaic tiles in a bathroom remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small tiles like mosaics provide greater slip resistance on wet shower floors because the frequent grout lines create traction, while large-format tiles look cleaner and are easier to wipe down on bathroom walls. Large tiles reduce the number of grout joints, making shower walls and large bathroom floors feel more expansive and simpler to maintain. However, large tiles require an exceptionally flat substrate to prevent uneven edges, known as lippage. HH Remodeling levels wall and floor framing prior to setting large-format or marble tiles to ensure an even, flush finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small mosaics offer better grip on shower floors due to numerous grout lines, while large-format tiles are ideal on walls to minimize grout maintenance and expand the space.
